title: Recycle owned transfer buffers at the MSE boundary

definition.title: Recycle owned transfer buffers at the MSE boundary
definition.source_excerpt: Follow-on allocation optimization · P2 · extends R04, R26 · PROPOSED — NOT TESTED IN THIS PASS Hypothesis. Use a bounded pool of owned ArrayBuffer slabs between a producer worker and the main-thread append controller. After a safe acknowledgment, return storage for reuse instead of allocating a fresh fragment buffer every time. New question versus prior work. R26 limits messages and credits. This examines storage ownership and reuse under the append protocol; it is not another claim of zero-copy browser decoding. Source primitive. HTML defines transferable ArrayBuffer ownership. MSE has an asynchronous append lifecycle; the safe reuse point must be verified for the actual implementation and protocol. [S11, S3]
